rows.text: returns without work unless the call at `00185E50` + 0xC returns non-null, the byte at the result of the same call repeated at `00185E50` + 0x1A is non-zero and qword `+0xC0` of the result of the call at `00185E50` + 0x28 is non-null; then, from the floats of that `+0xC0` object (re-fetched through the call at `00185E50` + 0x66), writes to `rdx` the rows (`-[+0xC]`, `-[+0x1C]`, `[+0x2C]`) at `+0`, (`-[+0]`, `-[+4]`, `[+8]`) at `+0x10`, (`-[+0x10]`, `-[+0x14]`, `[+0x18]`) at `+0x20` and (`-[+0x20]`, `-[+0x24]`, `[+0x28]`) at `+0x30`, negating by XOR with the sign mask `01CEBDA0`; zeroes dwords `+0xC`, `+0x1C` and `+0x2C` and stores 1.0 (`0x3F800000`) at `+0x3C`

writes to `rcx` the transpose of the upper-left 3x3 of the float 4x4 at `rdx` (output `+0`, `+4`, `+8` = input `+0`, `+0x10`, `+0x20`, and likewise for the next two rows), stores at `+0x30`, `+0x34` and `+0x38` the negated dot products (sign flipped with the mask `01CEBDA0`) of input rows `+0`, `+0x10` and `+0x20` (x, y, z) with input row `+0x30` (x, y, z), zeroes dwords `+0xC`, `+0x1C` and `+0x2C`, and stores 1.0 (`0x3F800000`) at `+0x3C`

returns 0 when qword `0209BE80` is null, when bit 13 (`0x2000`) of its dword `+0x10F68` is set, or when the call at `0028F6A0` + 0x2A with that pointer plus `0xAB30` returns 0; otherwise returns 1 when bit 4 (`0x10`) of byte `+0x10F68` is set and 2 when it is clear (`neg`/`sbb`/`add 2`)

returns 0.0 when `rcx` is null, when its qword `+0xC0` is null or when the dword that pointer addresses is -1; returns -1.0 (`01CEBC9C`) when that pointer's word `+0` is `0xFFFF`, when qword `022C6F28` plus the signed word times 0x740 is zero, or when dword `+0x284` of that element is 0; otherwise tail-jumps through the site `002E4E00` + 0x45 with `rcx` = the element

computes two values from `rcx` and returns their OR: each is 1 when `rcx` is null, its qword `+0xC0` is null or the dword that pointer addresses is -1; 0 when that pointer's word `+0` is `0xFFFF`, when qword `022C6F28` plus the signed word times 0x740 is zero or when dword `+0x284` of that element is 0; and otherwise the result of the call at `002E71C0` + 0x60 with (element, 3) for the first value and of the call at `002E71C0` + 0xAE with (element, 4) for the second
copies the 16 bytes at `022CB6C0` to `rcx` (aligned `movaps` load, unaligned `movups` store)

returns 0 when the call at `003A7AE0` + 0x21 with byte `+0` of `rcx` returns null or the call at `003A7AE0` + 0x32 with (that result, byte `+1` of `rcx`) returns null; otherwise stores dword `+4` of `rcx` at dword `+0` of the second result, makes the call at `003A7AE0` + 0x4E with (that result + 4, `rcx+8`, byte `+2` of that result, read after the dword store and so byte 2 of the copied dword) and returns `rcx` plus the sign-extended `edx`

notes: 00185E50: all four calls go to the same callee; only the +0xC result is null-tested, the +0x1A result is dereferenced for the byte test, the +0x28 result for the +0xC0 test, the +0x66 result supplies the source. Element-scale bracket notation [+0xC] in the row means the float at that offset of the +0xC0 object. 00217610: the dot products are summed as (y*y + x*x) + z*z. 003A7AE0: the byte +2 read at 003A7B29 follows the dword store at 003A7B23 to the same object, so it is byte +6 of rcx; worth confirming the callee signature (it looks like a copy with a length) before stating more.
